about.title: About me
about.primary: I'm a final-year Computer Science student at Jain University, Bengaluru, focused on backend and AI systems. My work centers on LLM infrastructure and security engineering — systems that hold up to real scrutiny, including my own.
about.secondary: I build and audit my own projects end-to-end: cost-optimal LLM routing, PII redaction pipelines, fleet analytics. I publish what's wrong with my own code as readily as what works.

projects.title: AegisProxy
projects.description: LLM gateway that routes requests to the cheapest model that can still answer well. A 416-d context vector feeds two classifier heads and a LinUCB contextual bandit that keeps learning post-deployment. I built the security layer, then audited and published what was wrong with my own code.

projects.title: Cat FleetIQ
projects.description: A fleet control tower co-built with my team for Caterpillar's hackathon, earning a Special Mention. Turns live fleet and vehicle data into operational insight.

projects.title: AegisProxy BI
projects.description: Reads live deal and work-order data from monday.com and turns it into an executive briefing — revenue leakage, collection delays, and a data-quality confidence score across two joined boards, with no machine learning in the analytics layer, just carefully guarded arithmetic.

projects.title: IPL Match Prediction
projects.description: An IPL outcome-prediction model where I found a feature mathematically identical to the label, inflating accuracy to 96%. I removed it and report the real number: 54%.
